text:
erin: quick sync — we need a single source-of-truth for runtime error taxonomy + what infra signals feed the dashboard. thinking: timeouts, 5xx from proxy/modelserver, OOMs, preemptions, degraded-mode/fallback counts. who owns mapping? @matt @jess

matt: I can take mapping for runtime signals (modelserver + router). can we list exact signal names and tags we need?

jess: I'll own ingress/proxy side (nginx/edge) and correlate 5xx/524. need a clear id that ties a request end-to-end (trace_id?).

prashant: runtime can add `x-rw-trace` header. also propose tagging fallback events with `fallback_reason` and `fallback_variant`.

erin: yes — trace header + `fallback_reason` tag. also we should distinguish "soft quota" evictions from hard rejects.

alice: product asks dashboards to show: 1) error rates by cause, 2) fallback rate over time + which model variant, 3) p95 latency with/without fallback, 4) counts of degraded-mode activations and their durations.

matt: for instrumentation sources: runtime emits `runtime.error.{type}` metrics (type in [timeout, oom, model-5xx, kv-miss, fallback]) with labels: model, variant, region, route, trace_id(optional). proxy emits `edge.response.code` and `edge.timeout` metrics. k8s emits `pod.eviction`/`oom_kill` events.

jess: agree. question: how do we count a single user-visible failure that passes through multiple layers? e.g., proxy 504 -> runtime fallback -> success. Should we attribute to proxy timeout or fallback?

prashant: we should record both but dashboard needs primary cause heuristics. proposal: if fallback_count > 0 for request then primary = fallback, else if proxy_5xx present primary = proxy, else runtime_oom, else unknown. open to alternate weighting.

erin: that heuristic sounds good. include a panel that breaks out "primary cause" vs "secondary signals" so SREs can debug end-to-end.

alice: UX ask for rollouts: when we flip model variants we want per-variant fallback + latency trend and a small traffic-split timeline in the UI. can the telemetry team add `variant` label to fallback metrics?

matt: yes. will add `variant` and `policy` (routing policy name) to fallback metrics. also adding `routing_decision` label: "pinned|overflow|fallback|rate_limited".

jess: adding a sample log line for tracing in case folks want to grep raw logs:

```
ts=1719006543 level=info trace_id=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate model=gpt-x variant=quantized fallback_reason=cache_miss routing_decision=overflow status=200 latency_ms=314
```

prashant: Prometheus example for fallback rate per variant (suggested):
```
(sum by (variant) (increase(runtime_fallback_count[5m]))) / sum by (variant) (increase(runtime_request_count[5m]))
```
erin: good. next: degraded-mode activations. runtime will emit `degraded_mode_active` gauge with `session_id` and `duration_ms` as separate events. dashboard wants a count of activations and median duration.

alice: also product wants alerting: fallback rate > 2% sustained for 10min for high-traffic routes, and degraded-mode activations spike >5/min. can we get stable names for rules?

matt: propose alert names: `HighFallbackRate`, `DegradedModeSpike`, `RuntimeOOMsHigh`. will add to the playbook with runbook link.

jess: one caveat — billing/quotas: soft-quota evictions currently drop requests with a distinct code. please tag those with `quota_action=soft_reject|hard_reject`. we need them on dashboard too (product cares).

erin: action items:
- matt: publish telemetry mapping doc with metric names + labels by EOD Friday (1719000000+?).
- jess: add proxy correlation and examples + edge metric names.
- prashant: instrument fallback_reason and routing_decision on runtime, add `x-rw-trace` header.
- alice: create dashboard wireframe (panels + alerts) by Tue and share in this thread.

matt: acked.

jess: ack.

devex-bot: created ticket RW-5234 "telemetry: unify fallback/error taxonomy" and linked to this thread.

sre-bot: scheduled a short takeover drill for alerts schema review on Mon 15:00.

erin: perfect — thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after docs + wireframe. :thumbsup:
